tasks.label: A1 · 一键开工（真机：驱动 + MoveIt + 场景 + 状态）
tasks.detail: 已有驱动/MoveIt 就直接复用；没有就在后台起（日志在 runtime/logs/real_startup_*.log，关掉终端也不会停），等就绪后把夹具加进规划场景，最后打印四项状态。控制器仍保持 inactive——那是 A2 的事。
tasks.command:
source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; if [ -z "$CS625_ROBOT_IP" ]; then echo "[A1] CS625_ROBOT_IP 未设置：写进 ~/.cs625_local.env"; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p runtime/logs; nodes=$(ros2 node list 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s
' "$nodes" | grep -qx '/eli_ros2_control_node' && printf '%s
' "$nodes" | grep -qx '/move_group'; then echo "[A1] 驱动和 MoveIt 已在运行，跳过启动"; else log="runtime/logs/real_startup_$(date +%H%M%S).log"; echo "[A1] 启动 驱动 + MoveIt（日志 $log；后台常驻，关掉这个终端也不会停）"; setsid nohup ros2 launch cs625_bringup real_base.launch.py launch_driver:=true robot_ip:="$CS625_ROBOT_IP" description_package:=eli_cs_robot_description description_file:=cs625.urdf.xacro headless_mode:=true launch_moveit:=true launch_rviz:=false activate_joint_controller:=false execute:=false require_confirmation:=true > "$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & for i in $(seq 1 45); do nodes=$(ros2 node list 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s
' "$nodes" | grep -qx '/eli_ros2_control_node' && printf '%s
' "$nodes" | grep -qx '/move_group'; then break; fi; sleep 2; done; if ! printf '%s
' "$nodes" | grep -qx '/move_group'; then echo '[A1] 90 秒内没等到 MoveIt，日志末尾：'; tail -15 "$log"; exit 1; fi; fi; echo "[A1] 把真机夹具加进规划场景"; python3 scripts/apply_real_cell_scene.py || exit 1; echo; echo "[A1] 四项状态（控制器此时应仍是 inactive，等 A2 激活）"; printf "  safety_mode : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/safety_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; printf "  robot_mode  : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/robot_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; printf "  controller  : "; ros2 control list_controllers --controller-manager "${CS625_CONTROLLER_MANAGER:-/eli_ros2_control_node}" 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="arm_controller"{print $NF}'; echo "  health      :"; python3 scripts/control_health.py || true; echo; echo "[A1] 下一步：A2 开动（激活控制器）；要采数据/建模时跑 P3 相机 → P4"

tasks.label: A2 · 开动（激活控制器 + 四项检查）
tasks.detail: 把执行权交给 arm_controller，然后打印四项：safety_mode=1 / robot_mode=7 / controller=active / control_health 三 True。激活后再检查一次状态，避免被 switch_controllers 的退出码误导（控制器已 active 时它会返回 1，属正常）。这是动臂前最后一次人工确认。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; cm="${CS625_CONTROLLER_MANAGER:-/eli_ros2_control_node}"; ac="${CS625_ARM_CONTROLLER:-arm_controller}"; echo "[A2] 激活 $ac（把执行权交给控制器）"; ros2 control switch_controllers --controller-manager "$cm" --activate "$ac" --strict || true; state=$(ros2 control list_controllers --controller-manager "$cm" 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="arm_controller"{print $NF}'); if [ "$state" != "active" ]; then echo "[A2] 激活失败：$ac 现在状态 = ${state:-未知}"; exit 1; fi; echo; echo "[A2] 四项检查"; printf "  safety_mode : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/safety_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; printf "  robot_mode  : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/robot_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; printf "  controller  : "; echo "$state"; echo "  health      :"; python3 scripts/control_health.py

tasks.label: B · 跑一次任务（dry-run / plan-only / execute）
tasks.detail: dry-run：只打印配置、模型检查和阶段表（模型过期时 exit 2）；plan-only：只做规划不动臂；execute：真动，3 秒内 Ctrl+C 可取消。需要相机与新鲜环境模型的只有 execute 的观测阶段。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; case "${input:runAction}" in dry-run) echo '[B] 预演：不动臂'; python3 scripts/run_task.py --scope ${input:scope} --mode ${input:mode} --world ${input:world} --dry-run ;; plan-only) echo '[B] 只规划：不动臂'; python3 scripts/run_task.py --scope ${input:scope} --mode ${input:mode} --world ${input:world} --plan-only ;; execute) echo '[B] 真动：${input:scope}/${input:mode} @ ${input:world}，3 秒内可 Ctrl+C'; sleep 3; python3 scripts/run_task.py --scope ${input:scope} --mode ${input:mode} --world ${input:world} --confirm ;; *) echo '未知 runAction'; exit 1 ;; esac

tasks.label: C · 离线测试（pytest + 契约，不碰机器人）
tasks.detail: 改代码后先跑它：pytest 全量 + 仓库契约检查，任一失败非零退出。不需要真机、不需要相机。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; echo '[C] pytest'; python3 -m pytest test/ -q; rc1=$?; echo '[C] 契约检查'; python3 test/contract_checks.py; rc2=$?; if [ $rc1 -ne 0 ] || [ $rc2 -ne 0 ]; then echo '[C] 失败：先修测试再碰真机'; exit 1; fi; echo '[C] 全部通过'

tasks.label: P1 · 环境校验（换终端/改代码后跑）
tasks.detail: source_dev_env.sh --full --verify：ROS Jazzy → 厂商 underlay → 本仓库 overlay。最后打印 OK 才是环境链正常。

tasks.label: P2 · 构建 overlay（改了包之后）
tasks.detail: 首次构建时 install/ 不存在，--full 会失败，所以回退 --no-overlay。
tasks.command: if ! source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; then echo '首次构建：overlay 不存在，改用 --no-overlay'; source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --no-overlay || exit 1; fi; bash scripts/build.sh

tasks.label: P3 · 相机（modeling / fast / status）
tasks.detail: camera_mode.py 自己加载 camport 工作区。实测：modeling=1280x960 有深度（约 0.8 fps，建模/观测用）；fast=640x480 彩色-only、25 fps（无深度）。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; case "${input:cameraMode}" in modeling) echo '[P3] 精细模式 1280x960（有深度）'; python3 scripts/camera_mode.py modeling ;; fast) echo '[P3] 高帧率模式（彩色 25 fps，无深度）'; python3 scripts/camera_mode.py fast ;; status) python3 scripts/camera_mode.py status ;; *) echo '未知 cameraMode'; exit 1 ;; esac

tasks.label: P4 · 采集 + 建模 + 门禁（capture / rebuild / verify）
tasks.detail: capture：臂会动，绕工件采多视角（需相机 modeling）；rebuild：用指定数据集重建 runtime/environment；verify：只判门禁（偏差/点数/年龄）。模型超过 2 小时会被 B 的 dry-run/execute 拒绝。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; case "${input:modelAction}" in capture) ds="${input:datasetDir}"; [ -n "$ds" ] || ds="$HOME/cs625_yolo_seg/datasets/$(date +%F)_raw"; echo "[P4] 臂会动：采多视角 → $ds"; python3 scripts/capture_dataset.py --out "$ds" --tag workpiece ;; rebuild) ds="${input:datasetDir}"; if [ -z "$ds" ]; then echo "[P4] rebuild 需要数据集目录（capture 输出的那个）"; exit 1; fi; echo "[P4] 用 $ds 重建模型"; python3 scripts/model_environment.py --dataset "$ds" --out runtime/environment ;; verify) echo '[P4] 只判门禁'; python3 scripts/model_environment.py --out runtime/environment --verify-only ;; *) echo '未知 modelAction'; exit 1 ;; esac

tasks.label: P5 · 规划场景（apply / verify / remove）
tasks.detail: 把真机夹具加进 MoveIt（A1 已自动做一次；重启 MoveIt 后要再做）。verify 直接问 /get_planning_scene 有没有 real_cell_slot_fixture。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; case "${input:sceneAction}" in apply) python3 scripts/apply_real_cell_scene.py ;; verify) out=$(timeout 25 ros2 service call /get_planning_scene moveit_msgs/srv/GetPlanningScene "{components: {components: 0}}" 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q "id='real_cell_slot_fixture'"; then echo '[P5] 夹具已在场景里'; else echo '[P5] 场景里没有夹具：先 apply'; exit 1; fi ;; remove) python3 scripts/apply_real_cell_scene.py --remove ;; *) echo '未知 sceneAction'; exit 1 ;; esac

tasks.label: P6 · 感知链路自检（相机 → /sensors/*）
tasks.detail: 只读：相机节点在不在、5 个话题各有几个 publisher。判读标准：/sensors/camera/points 必须 >0；为 0 说明归一化链路没通（real.yaml 的输入话题还空着）。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; echo '[P6] 相机节点'; if ros2 node list 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^/camera'; then ros2 node list | grep -E '^/camera'; else echo '  没有相机节点：先跑 P3'; fi; echo; echo '[P6] publisher 数'; for t in /camera/color/image_raw /camera/color/camera_info /camera/depth/image_raw /camera/depth/points /sensors/camera/points; do printf "  %-30s " "$t"; ros2 topic info "$t" 2>/dev/null | awk '/Publisher count/ {print $3}' | tr -d "\n"; echo; done; echo; echo '[P6] 判读：/sensors/camera/points 必须 >0'

tasks.label: P7 · 分步起真机（A1 失败时排查：base / moveit）
tasks.detail: 把 A1 拆开：base 只起驱动；moveit 只起 MoveIt（会先检查底座）。两个各占一个终端。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; case "${input:realStage}" in base) if [ -z "$CS625_ROBOT_IP" ]; then echo "CS625_ROBOT_IP 未设置"; exit 1; fi; echo "[P7] 驱动底座（控制器 inactive）"; ros2 launch cs625_bringup real_base.launch.py launch_driver:=true robot_ip:="$CS625_ROBOT_IP" description_package:=eli_cs_robot_description description_file:=cs625.urdf.xacro headless_mode:=true launch_moveit:=false launch_rviz:=false activate_joint_controller:=false execute:=false require_confirmation:=true ;; moveit) if ! ros2 node list 2>/dev/null | grep -qx '/eli_ros2_control_node'; then echo '[P7] 底座没跑：先跑 base'; exit 1; fi; echo '[P7] MoveIt'; ros2 launch cs625_bringup real_moveit.launch.py description_package:=eli_cs_robot_description description_file:=cs625.urdf.xacro moveit_config_package:=elite_cs625_moveit_config semantic_package:=cs625_bringup semantic_file:=config/cs625_active_perception.srdf ;; *) echo '未知 realStage'; exit 1 ;; esac

tasks.label: P8 · 伪硬件冒烟（不接真机）
tasks.detail: use_fake_hardware=true：只验 URDF / ros2_control / 控制器链路。真机不可用时排查软件栈。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; ros2 launch cs625_bringup real_base.launch.py launch_driver:=true use_fake_hardware:=true description_package:=eli_cs_robot_description description_file:=cs625.urdf.xacro headless_mode:=true launch_moveit:=false launch_rviz:=false activate_joint_controller:=false execute:=false require_confirmation:=true

tasks.label: P9 · Qt 操作面板（B 的替代界面）
tasks.detail: cs625_ui.py：六个任务模式按钮。和 B 等价，二选一。

tasks.label: P10 · 实验归档
tasks.detail: 归档 runtime/experiments 最新一次到 ~/cs625_experiment_archive，并写 docs/evidence/experiment_index.md。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; archive_latest() { run=$(ls -td runtime/experiments/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$run" ]; then echo "没有可归档的 run"; return 1; fi; echo "[P10] 归档 $run"; python3 scripts/archive_experiment.py --run-dir "$run"; }; case "${input:archiveAction}" in latest) archive_latest ;; stop-and-archive) python3 scripts/experiment_recorder.py stop; archive_latest ;; *) echo "未知 archiveAction"; exit 1 ;; esac

tasks.label: P11 · 文件查看器（浏览器看视频/图片/日志）
tasks.detail: 只读网页服务（默认 $HOME，端口 8090），Windows 浏览器打开 http://localhost:8090/。

tasks.label: P12 · DSH Web（已开就只开浏览器）
tasks.detail: 探 127.0.0.1:3080/3081；没开就后台起 dsh web，从日志取带 token 的 URL 交给浏览器。
tasks.command: bash -lc 'cd "${workspaceFolder}" || exit 1; source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; ports="$CS625_DSH_PORT"; [ -n "$ports" ] || ports="3080 3081"; log="runtime/logs/dsh_web.log"; mkdir -p runtime/logs; ensure_node() { command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0; if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0; _nv=$(ls -d "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); if [ -n "$_nv" ]; then PATH="$_nv:$PATH"; export PATH; fi; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; }; dsh_cmd() { if command -v dsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo dsh; return 0; fi; _np=$(ls -dt "$HOME"/.npm/_npx/*/node_modules/.bin/dsh 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$_np" ] && [ -x "$_np" ]; then echo "$_np"; return 0; fi; _gm="$(npm root -g 2>/dev/null)/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js"; if [ -f "$_gm" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "node $_gm"; return 0; fi; return 1; }; listening() { (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$1") 2>/dev/null && return 0; command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1 && ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q "127.0.0.1:$1 " && return 0; return 1; }; url_from_log() { if [ -f "$log" ]; then grep -o "http://127.0.0.1:$1/[^ ]*token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]*" "$log" | tail -1; fi; }; active=""; for p in $ports; do if listening "$p"; then active="$p"; echo "[99.1] 127.0.0.1:$p 已在监听"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$active" ]; then ensure_node || true; cmd=$(dsh_cmd) || cmd=""; if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then echo "[99.2] 找不到 dsh/node"; exit 1; fi; : > "$log"; setsid nohup $cmd web --no-open --port 3080 >>"$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo "[99.2] 已后台启动 (pid $!)"; for i in $(seq 1 60); do listening 3080 && break; sleep 0.25; done; active=3080; fi; url=$(url_from_log "$active"); [ -n "$url" ] || url="http://127.0.0.1:$active/"; echo "[99.3] 打开 $url"; if command -v xdg-open >/dev/null 2>&1; then xdg-open "$url" >/dev/null 2>&1; elif grep -qi microsoft /proc/version 2>/dev/null && command -v cmd.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd.exe /c start "" "$url" >/dev/null 2>&1; else echo '[99.3] 手动打开上面的 URL'; fi'

inputs.description: 数据集目录（capture 默认今天；rebuild 必填）
